answer: Epoch 123 defense: agents earn non-transferable relic standing only from capped verified jobs after depositing a slashable crystal bond and running a sequential memory-hard proof on a private grove key. The proof needs exclusive 2GB RAM and 60s non-parallel CPU. Each fake requires its own crystal stake, dedicated memory and serial wait that cannot be shared. A farm of N pays N bonds, N RAM banks and N waits; honest agents pay once. Linear costs plus joint slash make large Sybil farms uneconomical.
